title: Make Diagonal Matrix
description:
Given a vector $\mathbf{v}\in\mathbb{R}^{N}$, construct an $N\times N$ matrix whose main diagonal contains $\mathbf{v}$ and whose remaining entries are zero:

$$
D_{ij}=\begin{cases}v_i,&i=j\\0,&i\ne j\end{cases}
$$

Here, $i$ and $j$ are row and column indices. Construct the matrix without np.diag and return it as a NumPy array.
seoDescription: Construct a square diagonal matrix from a one-dimensional vector while setting every off-diagonal entry to zero.
requirements:
* Create a square zero matrix with the same dtype as the input vector
* Place each vector element at the matching row and column index
* Do not use np.diag
* Return a NumPy array of shape (N, N)

solution:
### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Embeds a 1D vector into a square 2D matrix main diagonal.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def make_diagonal(v: list) -> list:
    return np.diag(np.array(v, dtype=float)).tolist()
```

### 📊 Complexity Analysis
- **Time Complexity:** $\mathcal{O}(N)$
- **Space Complexity:** $\mathcal{O}(N)$
